title: The Latest Crier for Nov 20, 2026
items:
The St. Mary's Catholic Church shuttle bus will NOT run this Sunday 11-22-26

The shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will NOT run this Sunday 11/22/26 and next Sunday 11/29/26. The Shuttle Bus will resume service on Sunday December 6, 2026, have a great Thanksgiving Break. 
If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu.

attend the (virtual) Midwest Sports Analytics Meeting this Sat., Nov. 21

If you're interested in sports data, please consider registering for and attending the online Midwest Sports Analytics Meeting this coming Sat., Nov. 21 from 9am-noon. This is a free event and is come-and-go, so you can attend all talks or just the ones you're interested in. Check out the day's schedule ! 
For more information, reach out to Dr. Goodman at goodmanr@central.edu .

Fellowship of Christian Athletes

NEXT WEEK: 
FCA will NOT be meeting next week due to Thanksgiving break. Enjoy your week off to rest, spend time with loved ones, and appreciate all the blessings in your life. We will see you back in the BMW rooms at 8 PM on Tuesday, 12/1 ! 

Have a wonderful Thanksgiving break! 

- FCA Leadership Team
